flows.name: Room-aware cleaning
flows.text: Rooms owns designated tiles/access → Quartermaster locates configured supplies → Auto Clean executes native cleaning and returns tools. Current native dedicated acceptance remains pending.

flows.name: Physical storage records
flows.text: Quartermaster 0.17 ledger-freshness: room-aware physical inspections → paper ledger → selected CD → powered native desktop → browsing and freshness-gated collection. Uses native computer power, not a confirmed Power-mod integration.

flows.name: UV defense and infected ecology
flows.text: Power owns energy; SPXTRM owns light/UV; MORTIS provides anatomy/behavior; Nightfall chooses infected responses and research content. Dedicated AI acceptance remains blocked.

flows.name: Recovered parts and effigies
flows.text: MORTIS preserves anatomy/provenance → Health Care validates timed corpse recovery → Nightfall validates same-source parts for effigy assembly/feeding. Knowledge provides prerequisites, with multiplayer storage restrictions.

flows.name: Powered water infrastructure
flows.text: Power reserves exact energy; Water owns pumps, fluid/quality transactions and recovery. Energy and fluid outcomes must reconcile; offline contracts do not prove native replication.

flows.name: UVC water treatment
flows.text: SPXTRM timed action revalidates reach and placed source, recomputes optical conditions → Water transaction changes biological quality only. Opt-in default off; not universal sterilization/potability.

flows.name: Sunburn care
flows.text: SPXTRM owns dose; Health Care owns procedure validation. Health Care 0.11 branch adds timed self-only cold-pack consumption. Root 0.10.1 is not that branch; no native runtime acceptance.

flows.name: Irrigation and crop lighting
flows.text: Harvest calculates demand and can apply provider-delivered uses; Weather gives seasonal observations; SPXTRM samples crop light without growth changes. Automatic Waterworks supply and growth bonuses are not implemented.

flows.name: Storm-aware infrastructure
flows.text: Weather publishes bounded storm/wind facts. Power has a current catch-up reader, but Weather push targets old powerWorks global. Consequence proposals do not automatically damage equipment.

flows.name: Preservation appliances
flows.text: Food process framework coordinates optional fluid/energy reservations and owner outcomes. No first-party production process/station/recipe chosen; paired API identities need verification.

flows.name: Qualified excavation machinery
flows.text: CAT machine work + Earthworks terrain/routes/manual issuance + Knowledge qualifications. Legacy IDs and active Earthworks Java bridge prevent treating this as a supported Lua-only integrated build.

flows.name: Research and progression content
flows.text: Domain projects own their content; Knowledge owns definitions/prerequisites/claims. A declared dependency does not unblock multiplayer mutation: MULTIPLAYER_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE remains explicit.

flows.name: Active/inactive infected profiles
flows.text: MORTIS takes precedence over standalone Active Hours according to its current guide. Production solar profiles remain design/proof scope; Nightfall already owns its own UV/shelter behavior. Combined policy still needs acceptance.

flows.name: Future salvage ecosystem
flows.text: Junk Drawer can inspect/profile salvage; future domain recipes may produce electrical, optical, food or medical materials. No certified first-party recipes or confirmed adapters yet.
